scripts.local: node scripts/require-data.mjs otomads && node scripts/data-tool.mjs otomads -m otomads.local_source --config local-source.toml
scripts.build: node scripts/build-datasets.mjs && node scripts/run.mjs uv run --project tools python -m tmc.build && tsc --noEmit && vite build && node scripts/gen-notices.mjs --dist-only && node scripts/gen-headers.mjs
scripts.license:lint: node scripts/run.mjs uvx --with charset-normalizer --from reuse==6.2.0 reuse lint
scripts.data:test: node scripts/run.mjs uv run --project tools pytest tools/tests
scripts.data:build: node scripts/build-datasets.mjs && node scripts/run.mjs uv run --project tools python -m tmc.build
scripts.gate: node scripts/build-datasets.mjs && node scripts/run.mjs uv run --project tools python -m tmc.build && node scripts/run.mjs uv run --project tools python -m tmc.validate --report && node scripts/gen-notices.mjs --check
scripts.data:validate: node scripts/run.mjs uv run --project tools python -m tmc.validate --report
scripts.data:roster: node scripts/run.mjs uv run --project tools python -m tmc.roster
scripts.data:scaffold: node scripts/run.mjs uv run --project tools python -m tmc.roster --scaffold
scripts.audio:fetch: node scripts/require-data.mjs otomads && node scripts/data-tool.mjs otomads -m otomads.fetch_audio --config local-source.toml
scripts.audio:measure: node scripts/require-data.mjs otomads && node scripts/data-tool.mjs otomads -m otomads.loudness
scripts.media:pack: node scripts/require-data.mjs otomads && node scripts/data-tool.mjs otomads -m otomads.stage_media pack --library .music --cards cards-otomads --out otomads-media.tar.gz
scripts.media:stage: node scripts/require-data.mjs otomads && node scripts/data-tool.mjs otomads -m otomads.stage_media stage --from .music --cards cards-otomads --out dist
scripts.media:pull: node scripts/require-data.mjs otomads && node scripts/require-env.mjs OTOMADS_MEDIA_URL && node scripts/data-tool.mjs otomads -m otomads.stage_media stage --archive $OTOMADS_MEDIA_URL --out dist
